intro: Full stories from the road, in seven chapters: world rally stages in the Chilean forest, raid buggies in the Atacama, IndyCar on the streets of Long Beach, race days and parades, faces, border light in Tijuana, glass towers in San Diego, the coast from the air, and the Andes. Every frame is my own work, re-edited and cropped for the web.
